---
title: "Phage-bacteria alpha and beta diversities"
output: html_document
date: "2025-11-14"
---

```{r}
## ---- Load the following libraries ----------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(vegan)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
library(here)

## ---- Inputs --------------------------------------------
phage_file <- here("data", "results_with_metadata.csv")
bact_file  <- here("data", "mmc3.xlsx")

## ---- Output directories --------------------------------
fig_dir       <- here("results", "figures", "alpha_beta_diversity")
fig_phage_dir <- file.path(fig_dir, "phages")
fig_bact_dir  <- file.path(fig_dir, "bacteria")

dir.create(fig_dir,       recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_phage_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_bact_dir,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## ---- Colors --------------------------------------------
cols_time <- c(
  "1 week"   = "blue",
  "1 month"  = "darkgreen",
  "6 months" = "mediumaquamarine",
  "12 months"= "gold",
  "mothers"  = "purple4"
)

## ---- Load data from phages -----------------------------
df_phage <- read.csv(phage_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

## ---- Abundance in CPM per vOTU -------------------------
phage_abundance <- df_phage %>%
  select(Sample, vOTUs, CPM) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = vOTUs, values_from = CPM, values_fill = 0)

## ---- Load the specific metadata ------------------------
# Metadata 
phage_meta <- df_phage %>%
  select(Sample, timepoint_months, mother_infant, bodysite) %>%
  distinct()

# Abundance matrixes: rows are samples, columns are vOTUs
phage_mat <- phage_abundance %>%
  column_to_rownames("Sample") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Shannon phages
shannon_phage <- diversity(phage_mat, index = "shannon")

# stool_data
stool_data <- phage_meta %>%
  mutate(
    shannon_index = shannon_phage[Sample],
    timepoint_label = case_when(
      timepoint_months == 0.25 & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 week",
      timepoint_months == 1    & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 month",
      timepoint_months == 6    & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "6 months",
      timepoint_months == 12   & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "12 months",
      timepoint_months == 1    & mother_infant == "mother" & bodysite == "stool" ~ "mothers"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(timepoint_label)) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_label = factor(timepoint_label,
                             levels = c("1 week", "1 month", "6 months", "12 months", "mothers"))
  )

# Df of alpha diversity for phages
alpha_phage <- stool_data %>%
  select(Sample, timepoint_label, shannon_index) %>%
  mutate(
    community = "phage",
    shannon   = shannon_index
  )

## ---- Load data from bacteria -----------------------------
bact_raw <- read_excel(bact_file)
stopifnot("clade_name" %in% names(bact_raw))

# Values 0–100 
bact_num <- bact_raw %>%
  mutate(across(-clade_name, ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(.))) / 100))

# Taxons x samples
bact_mat <- bact_num %>%
  select(-clade_name) %>%
  as.matrix()
rownames(bact_mat) <- bact_num$clade_name

# Transpose: rows are samples, columns are taxons
bact_mat_t <- t(bact_mat)

# Shannon bacterias
shannon_bact <- diversity(bact_mat_t, index = "shannon")

# Df with Sample + Shannon
bact_alpha_df <- data.frame(
  Sample       = rownames(bact_mat_t),
  shannon_bact = shannon_bact,
  row.names    = NULL
)

# Same metadata as phages for bacteria
bact_alpha_df <- bact_alpha_df %>%
  inner_join(phage_meta, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_label = case_when(
      timepoint_months == 0.25 & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 week",
      timepoint_months == 1    & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 month",
      timepoint_months == 6    & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "6 months",
      timepoint_months == 12   & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "12 months",
      timepoint_months == 1    & mother_infant == "mother" & bodysite == "stool" ~ "mothers"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(timepoint_label)) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_label = factor(timepoint_label,
                             levels = c("1 week", "1 month", "6 months", "12 months", "mothers"))
  )

alpha_bact <- bact_alpha_df %>%
  select(Sample, timepoint_label, shannon_bact) %>%
  mutate(
    community = "bacteria",
    shannon   = shannon_bact
  )

## ---- Alpha diversity -------------------------------------

# Combine in an object
alpha_combined <- bind_rows(alpha_phage, alpha_bact) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_label = factor(timepoint_label,
                             levels = c("1 week", "1 month", "6 months", "12 months", "mothers")),
    community       = factor(community, levels = c("phage", "bacteria"))
  )

# Alpha diversity of phages
p_alpha_phage <- ggplot(alpha_phage,
                        aes(x = timepoint_label, y = shannon, fill = timepoint_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = timepoint_label), width = 0.2, size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_time) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_time) +
  labs(
    title = "Alpha diversity (Shannon) – Phage community",
    x = "Age / group",
    y = "Shannon index"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_phage_dir, "alpha_phage.png"),
       p_alpha_phage, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)

# Alpha diversity of bacteria
p_alpha_bact <- ggplot(alpha_bact,
                       aes(x = timepoint_label, y = shannon, fill = timepoint_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = timepoint_label), width = 0.2, size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_time) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_time) +
  labs(
    title = "Alpha diversity (Shannon) – Bacterial community",
    x = "Age / group",
    y = "Shannon index"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_bact_dir, "alpha_bacteria.png"),
       p_alpha_bact, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)

ggsave(file.path(fig_bact_dir, "alpha_bacteria.pdf"),
       p_alpha_bact, width = 9, height = 7)


# ---- Alpha diversity phage + bacteria together  ----
p_alpha_both <- ggplot(alpha_combined,
                       aes(x = timepoint_label, y = shannon,
                           fill = timepoint_label, color = timepoint_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(alpha = community),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    width    = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(alpha = community),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.7),
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_time) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_time) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c(phage = 0.5, bacteria = 0.9),
    name   = "Community"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Alpha diversity (Shannon) – Phage vs bacteria",
    x = "Age / group",
    y = "Shannon index"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "alpha_phage_bacteria_together.png"),
       p_alpha_both, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "alpha_phage_bacteria_together.pdf"),
  plot = p_alpha_both,
  device = cairo_pdf,   # recomendado para paper
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  units = "in"
)

## ---- Beta diversity of phages (PCoA Bray–Curtis)----------
OTUDistMat <- vegdist(phage_mat, method = "bray")

pcoa_result <- cmdscale(OTUDistMat, eig = TRUE, k = 2)
eig_vals    <- pcoa_result$eig
var_expl    <- eig_vals / sum(eig_vals) * 100

pcoa_coords <- as.data.frame(pcoa_result$points)
colnames(pcoa_coords) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
pcoa_coords$Sample <- rownames(pcoa_coords)

metaDataFinal <- stool_data %>% select(Sample, timepoint_label, bodysite, mother_infant)
PCoA_df <- pcoa_coords %>%
  inner_join(metaDataFinal, by = "Sample") %>%
  filter(bodysite != "breastmilk")

pcoa_phage_plot <- ggplot(PCoA_df,
                          aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = timepoint_label)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = timepoint_label, color = timepoint_label),
               type = "t", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_time, name = "Age") +
  labs(
    title = "Phage vOTU PCoA – Bray-Curtis",
    x = paste0("PCoA1 [", round(var_expl[1], 1), "%]"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 [", round(var_expl[2], 1), "%]")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title        = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_phage_dir, "beta_phage_pcoa.png"),
       pcoa_phage_plot, width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300)

ggsave(file.path(fig_phage_dir, "beta_phage_pcoa.pdf"),
       pcoa_phage_plot, width = 9, height = 8)

# PERMANOVA phages
otu_samples  <- labels(OTUDistMat)
meta_samples <- PCoA_df$Sample
common_samples <- intersect(otu_samples, meta_samples)

meta_filtered <- PCoA_df %>%
  filter(Sample %in% common_samples) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, common_samples))

dist_matrix_filtered <- as.dist(as.matrix(OTUDistMat)[common_samples, common_samples])

meta_filtered$timepoint_label <- factor(meta_filtered$timepoint_label)

adonis_phage <- adonis2(dist_matrix_filtered ~ timepoint_label,
                        data = meta_filtered, permutations = 999)
print(adonis_phage)

## ---- Beta diversity of bacteria (PCoA Bray–Curtis)---------

bact_bc <- vegdist(bact_mat_t, method = "bray")

bact_pcoa <- cmdscale(bact_bc, eig = TRUE, k = 2)
bact_eig  <- bact_pcoa$eig
bact_var_expl <- bact_eig / sum(bact_eig) * 100

bact_coords <- as.data.frame(bact_pcoa$points)
colnames(bact_coords) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
bact_coords$Sample <- rownames(bact_coords)

bact_meta_for_pcoa <- bact_alpha_df %>%
  select(Sample, timepoint_label) %>%
  distinct()

bact_pcoa_df <- bact_coords %>%
  inner_join(bact_meta_for_pcoa, by = "Sample")

pcoa_bact_plot <- ggplot(bact_pcoa_df,
                         aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = timepoint_label)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = timepoint_label, color = timepoint_label),
               type = "t", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_time, name = "Age") +
  labs(
    title = "Bacterial community PCoA – Bray-Curtis",
    x = paste0("PCoA1 [", round(bact_var_expl[1], 1), "%]"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 [", round(bact_var_expl[2], 1), "%]")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title        = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_bact_dir, "beta_bacteria_pcoa.png"),
       pcoa_bact_plot, width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PDF
ggsave(file.path(fig_bact_dir, "beta_bacteria_pcoa.pdf"),
       pcoa_bact_plot, width = 9, height = 8)


## ---- PERMANOVA BACTERIA ----

samples_bact <- bact_pcoa_df$Sample

bact_mat_sub <- bact_mat_t[samples_bact, , drop = FALSE]

dist_bact_sub <- vegdist(bact_mat_sub, method = "bray")

meta_bact_sub <- bact_pcoa_df %>%
  select(Sample, timepoint_label) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_label = factor(timepoint_label)) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, samples_bact))

stopifnot(
  nrow(meta_bact_sub) == attr(dist_bact_sub, "Size"),
  all(meta_bact_sub$Sample == samples_bact)
)

adonis_bact <- adonis2(
  dist_bact_sub ~ timepoint_label,
  data = meta_bact_sub,
  permutations = 999
)

print(adonis_bact)

## ---- PANEL beta phages vs bacteria -----------------------

p_beta_both <- pcoa_phage_plot + pcoa_bact_plot +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Beta diversity – Phage vs bacterial communities")

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "beta_phage_bacteria_side_by_side.png"),
       p_beta_both, width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)

# PDF
ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "beta_phage_bacteria_side_by_side.pdf"),
  p_beta_both,
  width = 14, height = 7
)

```
